decisions.rationale: Exact task-instruction match to the red-cube task ("Pick the red cube and place it in the bowl"); confirmed real/public/non-placeholder on HF Hub. lerobot/smolvla_base zero-shot is confirmed non-viable (lerobot#2210 root cause: missing baked-in normalization stats, not an SO-101 incompatibility).

decisions.decision: Task stays the red cube pick (D-02), NOT Pen Transfer
decisions.rationale: A live mid-session discussion considered switching to the paper's Pen Transfer task for literature alignment, but the selected checkpoint is only trained on the red-cube task — since no fine-tuning happens in this phase, the checkpoint's own trained task determines what's actually achievable.

decisions.decision: Camera mapping: 3 real feeds — camera1=IMX335 wrist, camera2=AR0144 stereo LEFT half [0:1280], camera3=AR0144 stereo RIGHT half [1280:2560]
decisions.rationale: The selected checkpoint's config.json expects 3 real (non-empty) camera slots. Splitting the AR0144's single 2560x720 stereo frame into two genuinely distinct halves is a better fit than a dummy/duplicate 3rd slot. Implemented in Plan 11-04 Task 3 (control/vla_bridge/stereo_camera.py, StereoSplitCamera) — this task was added to 11-04-PLAN.md AFTER the plan was originally written/plan-checker-approved, once this camera decision was made live.

decisions.decision: Colab bridge: lerobot.async_inference gRPC PolicyServer/RobotClient + ngrok TCP tunnel (not HTTP)
decisions.rationale: Matches D-01's Colab-GPU-relay requirement; already shipped in installed lerobot==0.6.1, no hand-rolled serial/gRPC code needed. gRPC needs raw TCP — an HTTP-only tunnel would silently break it.

decisions.decision: pyngrok package legitimacy approved by human (visited pypi.org, confirmed ngrok/alexdlaird namespace, 8.1.2 real published version)
decisions.rationale: RESEARCH.md's Package Legitimacy Audit flagged pyngrok as SUS pending human sign-off before any Colab install cell runs it.

decisions.decision: Bridge safety design: never call RobotClient.control_loop_action()/control_loop() — those call robot.send_action() internally, unvalidated
decisions.rationale: Direct reading of installed lerobot 0.6.1 source (not just docs) found this would silently bypass VLAHW-02's safety validator. Plan 11-04 instead uses control_loop_observation() + a hand-rolled pop_validated_action() that always routes through safety_validator.validate_action() before any send_action() call.
